description: This Java source file defines a WearableListenerService that monitors connectivity status between a wearable device and a phone, managing notifications when the connection is lost or regained.

classes.name: DisconnectListenerService
classes.description: A service that listens for connectivity changes between a wearable device and a phone, managing user notifications accordingly.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient for wearable API communication.

methods.name: onConnectedNodes
methods.description: Handles the event when connected nodes are detected, triggering notification updates.

methods.name: setOrUpdateNotification
methods.description: Queries the capability API to determine if the 'find_me' capability is available on connected nodes.

methods.name: updateFindMeCapability
methods.description: Updates notifications based on the presence or absence of nearby nodes with the 'find_me' capability.

methods.name: setupLostConnectivityNotification
methods.description: Creates and displays a notification indicating the device has lost connection to the phone.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback when GoogleApiClient connects, triggers notification update.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Callback for when the GoogleApiClient connection is suspended.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up the GoogleApiClient connection when the service is destroyed.
